lede: Swift Tyre Specialist is a tyre and battery workshop at Premier@Kaki Bukit. Its own website lists tyre replacement and puncture repair, battery, starter and alternator replacement, wheel alignment and servicing, with islandwide roadside help.
themes: Customers on Google Maps mention very fast WhatsApp replies, on-site puncture repair and tyre replacement, a car battery replacement, wheel alignment and coilover fitting at competitive prices.
